The 2020 edition has no entity dimension, so the units carry the headings as printed.
meta.hierarchyProjection: USD whole/Part/section hierarchy with RB, OA and XB side by side, followed by a stable budget-unit tier. Printed entities remain entities; section-wide, programme, special-purpose and unitemized scopes use explicit neutral wrappers. Deeper rows preserve each selected source schedule instead of claiming one universal entity/component/subprogramme order. Selected lower outline: 40 source tables, 274 printed observations and 224 materialized lower nodes; 102 parallel tables and 0 other-currency tables remain outside additive arithmetic.
